profile.constituencyprofile_Text: The name Pulivendula is derived from the ancient term "Puli Mandala", meaning "land of tigers," indicating its forest origin. Many mandals in the constituency, including Pulivendula, Chakrayapet, Simhadripuram, Lingala, Vemula, and Vempalli, were officially formed in 1985. The constituency is home to several historically significant temples and spiritual landmarks: • Gandi Veeranjaneya Swamy Temple (Chakrayapet) – believed to be associated with Lord Rama and Treta Yuga. • Kona Malleswara Swamy Temple and Avula Swamy Temple (Lingala) • Sri Mopuri Byraveswara Swamy Temple (Vemula) • Bhanukoteswara Swamy Temple (Simhadripuram) • Anjaneyaswamy Temple at Gandi (near Vempalli) The region has also produced notable personalities such as the legendary comedian Padmanabham and film producers B. Narasimha Reddy and B. Nagi Reddy.
profile.geography: Pulivendula Constituency lies in the southwestern part of YSR Kadapa District, bordering Anantapur, Sri Sathya Sai, and Annamayya districts. It is approximately 48–85 km away from Kadapa city, the district headquarters.The region exhibits a mix of red loamy soils ,Black cotton soils

economy_text.economy_Text:
Pulivendula’s Economy at a Glance

Between 2024 and 2029, Pulivendula is poised for robust economic growth across its agricultural, industrial, and service sectors, driven by strategic investments and policy reforms. 

The agricultural sector will see significant expansion in horticulture (projected to grow from ₹5,559 cr to ₹11,676 cr), livestock, dairy, and aquaculture, fueled by micro-irrigation, digital platforms, and agro-processing clusters. 

The industrial sector will thrive through food processing, construction, and green energy initiatives, supported by industrial estates, MSME clusters, and infrastructure upgrades. 

The service sector will experience growth in transport, logistics (₹548 cr to ₹1,055 cr), tourism, real estate, and digital services, underpinned by connectivity improvements, urbanization, and e-governance. 

Cross-sectoral enablers, including investment-ready industrial parks, skill development, green infrastructure, and digital transformation, will further bolster Pulivendula’s economic trajectory, leveraging its natural advantages and fostering employment through agro-linkages, skill training, and a burgeoning digital economy.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Pulivendula is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like real estate, infrastructure, transport and agriculture. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant rural and economic hub by 2047
